name: l4_ground_radial_shear_micro_ladder_v1
description: Supported-chassis planted L4 micro radial-shear ladder at y=120 mm. Run five cycles each at 0.5, 1, 2, and 3 mm outward excursion, with 1 s midpoint, peak, and base dwells. This maps the reversal deadband below the prior 3.75 mm minimum. Soft torque 700; trip after three consecutive readings above 0.75 A; immediate ceiling 3.0 A. Adjacent legs L3/L5 ease to -35/+35 deg yaw to clear the camera view, then return to zero.
